data.body:
Implemented. Gerrit change 1459 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1459), commit b9a65d537d.

TDD evidence: oracle authored RED-first in tests/interfaces/queries/test_terminal_blocker_parity_e63c.py. Behavioral RED reproduced the reported split verbatim -- 'ready and next-batch disagree: ready=False batch=True' -- plus the archived case; a live-blocker negative control passed before and after.

Fix: rebar.types.TERMINAL_STATUSES = {closed, archived, deleted} + is_terminal_status(), imported by all four sites (graph/_ready.py, graph/_unblock.py, graph/_graph.py, _engine_support/next_batch.py). Phantom done/completed removed. _ready.py docstring now matches the implemented rule.

Teeth-check (mutation): narrowing the set to {closed} kills 7 tests; re-adding the phantoms kills 4; forcing the predicate True kills 7 (the negative control catches over-widening). Restored: 16/16 green.
Refactoring litmus: tests assert observable answers and cross-surface agreement only -- no module structure or call-site wiring is pinned.

Pre-flight: make lint clean, make typecheck clean (438 files), 648 tests green across tests/interfaces/queries + tests/scripts/graph + lifecycle + delete-unlink.
